hello.title: Hello!
hello.text: Here you keep track of what you eat during the day. No calories and no maths.
hello.nameLabel: What should the app call you?
hello.dayText: Anything you eat before then still counts for the day before. A snack at half past midnight, for example.

tap.title: Tap, done
tap.text: Had something to eat? Tap the matching tile. That's all you need to do.
tap.hold: Press and hold a tile to edit it.
tap.more: If you like more detail, you can turn on a short note for each entry in the settings.

tree.title: Your tree
tree.text: For every day you log something, a leaf grows. Every 7 leaves a flower appears, every 30 an apple.
tree.more: If you take a few days off, your tree stays just as it is.

install.title: Put the app on your phone
install.text: Then you start it with one tap from the home screen, and it works without internet too.
